messages:
emily: Hey team — PR #4217 (docs/migration/prefetch-cache.md) is ready for review but I'm holding merge. We need runtime to confirm the default behavior for prefetch + cache fallback because the current wording could mislead users about when the KV cache is populated.

sam: quick answer: default is prefetch disabled unless route config sets `prefetch: true`. When prefetch is enabled we warm the KV cache after a successful non-streaming response; on fallback we do not write to cache. Streaming/partial-token responses do not populate KV. I'll add detail.

alex: heads-up: the SDK snippet in the PR currently shows `client.prefetch = true` which is incorrect. Prefetch is a server/route config, not a client-side flag. We should show server YAML + a minimal client call. I can update if we all agree.

mike: CI is failing linkcheck on an internal anchor (batching-guide). Also the docs preview renders the example YAML weirdly (extra indent). Can we get those fixed before merging?

emily: @sam could you add a small "runtime note" block explaining streaming/partial-token behavior? That should unblock reviewers. @alex please update the snippet to server config examples.

sam: sure. Proposed text: "When prefetch is enabled, the runtime attempts to populate the KV cache only after a non-streaming successful completion (status 200). If the response is delivered via streaming or an early error occurs, the cache is not updated to avoid inconsistent prefixes." — does that read okay?

alex: LGTM. For the SDK example I'll show server config YAML plus a minimal client call, e.g.:
```yaml
route: /chat
prefetch: true
model: gpt-small-v1
```
then `client.chat.create({ route: '/chat', input: 'hi' })`.

deploy-bot: docs-preview: built successfully for PR #4217 — https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/4217 (note: linkcheck shows 1 warning).

mike: linkcheck warning is the renamed heading in batching-guide — I'll push a tiny fix to update the link target.

emily: Plan: sam adds the runtime note, alex updates snippets, mike fixes the anchor. Once CI (linkcheck + preview) are green I'll merge. Please ping me when pushed.

sam: Done — pushed runtime note and clarified streaming behavior (rev a1b2c3).

alex: Snippet fixed and pushed, added server YAML and minimal client example.

deploy-bot: docs-preview: rebuilt for PR #4217 — https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/4217 (all checks passed).

emily: Merging now. Thanks all! :tada:
